name: Alielle Ralielle
original_name: アレーレ・レレライル
source: Alielle is an assistant to Rune Venus. Though young, she is an expert guide over the lands of El-Hazard. This little seductress also happens to have a liking for other women. A very active young girl, she seems to like being with Makoto (she feels safer around him).
